A '''utility crane ship''' was a small spacecraft used to carry loads with a utility crane.

==History==
[[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], owner of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], used such a vessel both as an emergency escape craft as well as a liquor transport. Whenever large freighters would orbit [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Chalmun used it to collect liquor imports for his establishment. He kept it in a small hangar at the back of the cantina, where his mechanic kept it maintained.
